newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - Washington Post business - May 7.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Washington Post business - May 7.

text.p: The Washington Post carried the following stories on the front page of its business section on May 7:
WASHINGTON - Local telephone giant GTE Corp. said it would buy Internet service pioneer BBN Corp. for $616 million in cash.
WASHINGTON - Customers who don't generate much in fees or interest income for NationsBank Corp. are being asked to wait, quite literally, behind those who do.
WASHINGTON - More than 31 million Americans age 18 or older regularly use the Internet or commercial online services, according to a newly released study.
WASHINGTON - Ritz Camera Centers Inc., one of the country's largest chains, announced plans to buy 16 stores in California, South Carolina and Tennessee for an undisclosed sum.
LONDON - The five-day old administration of British Prime Minister Tony Blair surprised the financial community with a wholesale shakeup of the machinery of monetary policy in Britain.
